args.code: (() => { const g = window.game; if (!g) return {error:'no game object'}; const save = g.saveManager ? g.saveManager.getCurrentSave() : (g.state || {}); const skills = g.skillSystem ? g.skillSystem.getAllSkills() : {}; const npcs = g.npcSystem ? g.npcSystem.getAllNPCs() : []; const events = g.eventSystem ? g.eventSystem.getHistory() : []; const weather = g.weatherSystem ? g.weatherSystem.getCurrentWeather() : {}; const stats = g.stats ? g.stats : {}; const fields = g.fieldSystem ? g.fieldSystem.getFields() : []; return JSON.stringify({ day: g.day, season: g.season, time: g.time, money: g.money, stamina: g.stamina, maxStamina: g.maxStamina, health: g.health, maxHealth: g.maxHealth, fieldsCount: fields.length, fields: fields.map(f => ({ crop: f.crop ? f.crop.name : '无', stage: f.crop ? f.crop.stage : '-', daysLeft: f.crop ? f.crop.daysLeft : 0 })), eventsToday: g.eventsToday || 0, eventHistoryCount: events.length, skills: skills, npcs: npcs.map(n => ({ name: n.name, favor: n.favor })), reputation: g.reputation || 0, mood: g.mood || 0, weather: weather, mode: g.mode, disasterRate: g.disasterRate, house: g.house, quests: g.quests, pets: g.pets, stats: stats, researchPoints: g.researchPoints, storageCapacity: g.storageCapacity, daysPlayed: g.daysPlayed }); })()
